comment: SPEC 9.1's restated `tlog-policy` grammar, one whole policy per rule, each differing from a valid one in exactly one way. A case with `accept` true MUST parse; the rest MUST be refused. The text is the file verbatim and requires its final line feed. A case with `evaluate` also says what its quorum MEANS: each entry gives a set of cosigner names and whether they satisfy it, which is the only way a reader's arithmetic can be checked

bad-control-del.says: all other bytes `0x00–0x08`, `0x0B–0x1F` and `0x7F` are an error

bad-control-in-comment.says: all other bytes `0x00–0x08`, `0x0B–0x1F` and `0x7F` are an error

bad-control-nul.says: all other bytes `0x00–0x08`, `0x0B–0x1F` and `0x7F` are an error

bad-control-unit-separator.says: all other bytes `0x00–0x08`, `0x0B–0x1F` and `0x7F` are an error
